subject: Administrative Reorganization and Staff Position Amendments
overview: The council reviewed several mayoral proposals for administrative reorganization, including creating a Chief of Staff position and extending the City Solicitor's term, most of which were tabled for further information. Members also approved various local resolutions regarding public safety, budget transparency, and commendations for student athletes.

items.title: Sports Commendations
items.summary: Commended Medford High School varsity teams and Junior Mustangs football and cheerleading squads for league and regional championships.

items.title: City Solicitor Term (16-020)
items.summary: Tabled a proposal to extend the City Solicitor's term from one to two years to run concurrently with the Mayor's term until specific budgetary questions are answered.

items.title: Chief of Staff and Policy (16-021)
items.summary: Tabled an ordinance to create the position of Chief of Staff and Policy pending a broader review of the executive office's organizational chart and secretarial needs.

items.title: Chief Budget and Procurement Officer (16-022)
items.summary: Tabled a proposal to combine procurement and budget responsibilities into a single position following discussion regarding required certifications and potential conflicts of interest.

items.title: Compensation Plan Amendments (16-023)
items.summary: Tabled corresponding amendments to the city compensation plan for the newly proposed administrative roles.

items.title: Employee Vacation Accrual (16-024)
items.summary: Ordained an amendment allowing new employees to accrue vacation from their start date while restricting usage until after six months of service.

items.title: 2016 Goals and Veterans Committee
items.summary: Approved a Committee of the Whole meeting to set 2016 priorities and referred a proposal for a Veterans Advisory Committee to the Veterans Subcommittee.

items.title: 311 Call Reports and Outreach (16-015, 16-016)
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting monthly 311 reports and an update from the Substance Abuse Outreach and Prevention Coordinator upon her return from leave.

items.title: Budget Template Format (16-018)
items.summary: Approved a request for a new budget template featuring mission statements, performance metrics, and detailed narratives for each department.

items.title: Parking App Security and Maintenance (16-017, 16-026, 16-027)
items.summary: Approved requests for an update on smartphone parking app cybersecurity and ordered the removal of abandoned payphone stands and low-hanging wires.

items.title: Union and Swan Streets Parking Lot Petition
items.summary: Received and placed on file a petition to convert several blocks near the police station into a municipal parking lot or expanded city office space.

items.title: Tributes and Local Recognitions
items.summary: Observed a moment of silence for the late Governor's Councilor Michael J. Callaghan and recognized resident Johnny Amari for his 50th birthday.

items.title: Winchester Street and Cradock Bridge Safety
items.summary: Approved increased police patrols for the Winchester Street detour and referred a request regarding Jersey barriers near Cradock Bridge to the traffic commission.

items.title: Infrastructure Safety Program Update
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting an immediate status report from the administration regarding the pilot program for raised crosswalks and temporary speed bumps.
